description: Various jottings in Judaeo-Arabic and Arabic script including  ad raft of a legal declaration (aqūl wa-anā...) in Judaeo-Arabic, made by [...]r ha-Kohen b. Eliyyahu [... b.] Yeḥezqel ha-Rav ha-Gadol.
